title: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
summary: The Davidson Fellows Scholarship awards up to $100,000 to students aged 18 or younger who have completed a significant, graduate-level piece of work in STEM, Humanities, or Outside the Box.

evidence.quote: The deadline for receipt of all application materials is February 17, 2027, 11:59pm Pacific Time.
evidence.context: The deadline for receipt of all application materials is February 17, 2027, 11:59pm Pacific Time.

evidence.quote: Join us Thursday, November 12 at 4pm Pacific Time.
evidence.context: Learn more about application categories, eligibility, project criteria and more! Join us Thursday, November 12 at 4pm Pacific Time.

evidence.quote: All applicants are notified on or before July 15 each year.
evidence.context: All applicants are notified on or before July 15 each year.

eligibility.text: You must be 18 years old or younger as of the application deadline.

evidence.quote: Be 18 or younger as of the application deadline to be eligible.
evidence.context: Be 18 or younger as of the application deadline to be eligible.

eligibility.text: You must be a U.S. citizen residing in the U.S., a Permanent Resident residing in the U.S., or stationed overseas due to active U.S. military duty.

evidence.quote: Be a U.S. citizen residing in the United States, or a Permanent Resident of the United States residing in the United States, or be stationed overseas due to active U.S. military duty.
evidence.context: Be a U.S. citizen residing in the United States, or a Permanent Resident of the United States residing in the United States, or be stationed overseas due to active U.S. military duty.

eligibility.text: Students at any grade level may apply as long as they meet age and project requirements.

evidence.quote: The Davidson Fellows scholarship eligibility is based on age, not grade level. Students at any grade level are welcome to apply provided they meet our Eligibility and Project Criteria requirements.
evidence.context: The Davidson Fellows scholarship eligibility is based on age, not grade level. Students at any grade level are welcome to apply provided they meet our Eligibility and Project Criteria requirements.

evidence.quote: Not every applicant receives an Honorable Mention; they are featured on the Davidson Institute's website.
evidence.context: The Davidson Fellows Honorable Mention is intended to recognize applicants who have displayed notable potential in their field of study and strongly encourage them to continue pursuing their efforts and talents. Not every applicant receives an Honorable Mention; they are featured on the Davidson Institute's website.

submission.text: Initial portion describing the project/portfolio for eligibility review

evidence.quote: The initial portion asks for a brief description of the project/portfolio to ensure eligibility.
evidence.context: The application process has two parts! The initial portion asks for a brief description of the project/portfolio to ensure eligibility. The second part of the application is where you input your nominators’ information and send them their forms, as well as submit all the category requirements.

evidence.quote: Additionally in part two, you will input a parent’s information and send them their parent approval form(s).
evidence.context: Additionally in part two, you will input a parent’s information and send them their parent approval form(s). NOTE: only one parent approval form is required. If it is a team submission, one parent form is required per team member.

evidence.quote: Every applicant must submit the required elements outlined within their category of choice, plus two nominator forms and all of the Attachments.
evidence.context: Each category has different requirements. Every applicant must submit the required elements outlined within their category of choice, plus two nominator forms and all of the Attachments. Applicants and their parents also must sign a statement of commitment that, if named a Davidson Fellow, the applicant and a parent or guardian will attend the award reception in Washington, D.C.
evidence.section: What is required to apply for a Davidson Fellows scholarship?

flags.title: Winners and a parent must attend an in-person ceremony in Washington, DC
flags.explanation: You and a parent or guardian must be able to attend recognition events in Washington, D.C. in September if selected. Travel expenses and lodging are provided by the organizers.

evidence.quote: Davidson Fellows must be available to attend, with one parent or guardian, the awards reception and other recognition events to be held in September in Washington, DC.
evidence.context: Davidson Fellows must be available to attend, with one parent or guardian, the awards reception and other recognition events to be held in September in Washington, DC. (Travel expenses and lodging will be provided by the Institute.)

flags.title: Visual arts, live vertebrates, and community service projects are not eligible
flags.explanation: Projects in photography, film, visual arts, theater, community service, or research involving live vertebrates are not eligible for submission.

evidence.quote: Please note: Projects in the arts including photography, sculpture, film, visual, etc. are not eligible for consideration.
evidence.context: Please note: Projects in the arts including photography, sculpture, film, visual, etc. are not eligible for consideration.

flags.title: Google Docs and Google videos are not accepted for submission
flags.explanation: You cannot submit files hosted on Google services, such as Google Docs or videos hosted on Google Drive.

evidence.quote: GOOGLE PRODUCTS ARE NOT ACCEPTED, THIS INCLUDES GOOGLE DOCS AND VIDEOS.
evidence.context: GOOGLE PRODUCTS ARE NOT ACCEPTED, THIS INCLUDES GOOGLE DOCS AND VIDEOS.
